exclusion_rule: First-pass county removal: population-weighted valid sunshine coverage >=90% and estimated annual sunshine maximum across valid positive-population cells <1725h; altitude exclusion only when all inhabited grid cells are confirmed >2000m. Strong altitude samples with unsampled local cells remain pending.

sunshine_source.name: ScienceDB V8 China 1km monthly mean sunshine percentage
sunshine_source.variable: sunp monthly mean percentage of sunshine
sunshine_source.conversion: monthly sunp fraction × mean astronomical day length for that month × mean month days; summed over 12 months
sunshine_source.license: not independently confirmed on ScienceDB landing page; exploratory screening evidence

population_source.name: WorldPop 2024 Global2 R2024B unconstrained population count grid
population_source.population_use: candidate inhabited-cell locator only; not a building/address register
population_source.license: CC BY 4.0; verify exact release terms before redistribution

elevation_source.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 via Open-Meteo Elevation API
elevation_source.method: main population cell first; only if >2,000m query up to 9 additional spatially dispersed populated cells to test lower-altitude exceptions

geometry_source.vintage: third-party coded GeoJSON; vintage/datum not independently certified

limitations: This is a first-pass nationwide funnel, not final city-level certification.
The 2,847 roster and third-party county geometry remain provisional; 9 roster units have no exact code/name geometry match and are pending.

WorldPop R2024B unconstrained population is a modelled population surface, not a building or address register; it identifies candidate inhabited cells and does not prove that a particular cell is an actual retirement residential site.

Sunshine hours are derived from monthly mean sunshine percentage and astronomical day length, not directly summed from daily sunshine observations; the 75-hour guard band prevents borderline hard exclusions.
Altitude samples are selected from populated 1km grid cells; counties with more than 10 inhabited cells and all 10 samples above 2,000m remain pending for local low-altitude exception checks.
A county is an indexing unit, not a claim that its entire territory is one residential area. Separate valleys, basins, and populated settlements must remain independently evaluable.

data_quality_policy.missing_data: Use available valid data; below 90% coverage is pending and does not block other units.
data_quality_policy.use: Low-confidence data may support provisional comparison but is not the sole basis for hard exclusion.

population_method_caveat: WorldPop R2024B unconstrained 1km is a practical inhabited-cell proxy, not a building/address register. Use this as a national first-pass screen; refine settlement locations only for shortlisted areas.
